'''Imos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served in the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]], an elite section of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Assault Empire" /> In [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Imos was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Assault on Tython|assault on]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] where he engaged an Imperial strike team, but was struck down.<ref name="Assault Empire" />
